$comment: The compile-time and launch-time rejections of the v1 playground, and for each one the stable identifying prefix of the diagnostic it produces -- not always the whole string. Three of the six sites append a clause or a source location after this prefix: the fp16 header appends "; use float32 instead", check-fp32.mjs appends " (path:line)", and the harness appends the kernel name and byte count. So the suite matches by substring, and a reworded suffix does not fail it while a reworded boundary does. fp64 is the one boundary two sites enforce, check-fp32.mjs writing " (path:line)" and website/src/lib/compilePipeline.ts writing " (source.cu:line)"; they share the prefix below, so it is one row and not two. Read by tests/scripts/compile-failure-test.mjs, which compiles each compile-phase fixture and asserts the prefix is what the shim emitted, and by website/src/components/ToolchainBoundaries.tsx, which renders it once something mounts it on the About tab; also by the two sites that enforce them, tests/scripts/compile-test.mjs and website/src/lib/compilePipeline.ts, which read their row here. The enforcement does not read this file and must not be made to: these strings are checked against the headers and scripts that write them, a row that is not a substring of the real diagnostic fails the suite, and the fix is always the row. fixture names a file in tests/cuda/ for phase "compile" and is empty for phase "launch", which no fixture exercises. Every unsupported-*.cu in tests/cuda/ must appear as some row's fixture, so a new fixture cannot be added without one. id is the stable key a caller looks a row up by when it has no fixture to name it after -- the browser enforcing fp64 has no .cu file -- so it must stay put across a label rewording.

boundaries.message: HIP playground v1 is float32-only: fp64 is not supported
boundaries.label: fp64
boundaries.detail: A double-precision kernel is rejected at compile. There is no fp64 path in the model, so it is not approximated as fp32.

boundaries.message: HIP playground v1 does not support <cublas_v2.h>
boundaries.label: <cublas_v2.h>
boundaries.detail: Not shipped by the shim. There is no library path in the model.

boundaries.message: HIP playground v1 does not support <cuda_fp16.h>
boundaries.label: <cuda_fp16.h>
boundaries.detail: Half precision is not modelled. Use float32.

boundaries.message: HIP playground v1 does not support <cooperative_groups.h>
boundaries.label: <cooperative_groups.h>
boundaries.detail: Grid synchronisation is not modelled. There is a barrier primitive; there is no cooperative launch.

boundaries.message: atomic operations are not supported by the simulator in v1
boundaries.label: Atomics
boundaries.detail: atomicAdd and friends are a compile-time failure. A reduction that needs them has to be restructured.

boundaries.message: dynamic shared memory is not supported in v1
boundaries.label: Dynamic shared memory
boundaries.detail: cudaMalloc inside the kernel is rejected at launch. Use a static __shared__ array instead, which is what the LDS analyzer reads.
